scope: Only the McCutcheon asset and audit/mccutcheon_hall were edited. No master, README, manifest, BUILDINGS, shared script, other building, commit, or push.

changes.action: Set hide_render=true and preserved hide_viewport=false; added diagnostic-purpose/source-FID/source-URL custom properties.
changes.reason: It is an emissive GIS comparison trace, not built architecture or an on-site painted outline. It remains available in viewport comparisons and is omitted from architectural renders.

changes.action: Replaced gray Concrete_Pavement assignment with embedded procedural material MCUT_Grass_Lawn_Qualitative.
changes.reason: The broad landscape ground was visibly rendered as gray concrete. Official/context photos and the site's mapped landscape context support a lawn category. Exact grass color, species, and surface condition are not calibrated.

changes.action: Replaced Roof_Membrane assignment with embedded procedural material MCUT_Asphalt_Drive_Qualitative.
changes.reason: These context meshes represent drives, and a roof membrane was a semantically wrong material assignment. Asphalt appearance is qualitative and not measured from a site material sample.

gis.retrieved_for_this_pass: 2026-10-24; uses pre-existing retained project GIS snapshot

derived_frame.name: Project local approximate tangent plane
derived_frame.limitation: Approximation only; not survey control or a certified projected CRS.

gis.height_status: GIS num_levels_attribute=10 is marked unverified. Do not interpret as surveyed story count/height; the asset's 30.35 m top remains unverified.
gis.limitation: Bounding-box agreement and diagnostic polygon overlay are not full structural-wall shape verification, a survey, or evidence for facade/roof/height.
